steps.instruction: Pick up the tire on the left and the rim on the right.
Press the rim into the tire until the rubber sits evenly all the way around.

rule.question: Is the dark grey LEGO wheel hub pressed inside the black rubber tire, forming one wheel?

steps.instruction: Line up the wheel's center hole with the yellow axle pin on the left and press the wheel on.

rule.question: Is a black LEGO wheel mounted on the yellow axle pin on the side of the LEGO car?

steps.instruction: Check that the mounted wheel spins freely, then press Done.
